weekLabel.zh: 本周更新 · 9 月 14 日 – 9 月 20 日

title.zh: 迈阿密线下营销推进：横幅 10 月 10 日亮相，Rockstar 出资约 300 万美元
title.en: Miami outdoor campaign moves forward: banners land Oct 10, Rockstar pays ~$3M

summary.zh: Rockstar 与迈阿密市政敲定协议后，GTA6 户外宣传物料（海报、横幅等）计划 10 月 10 日正式亮相，覆盖迈阿密多个地点；沙滩椅与遮阳伞上将低调打上 "VI" 与 Vice City 标识。社交平台还流出疑似 GTA6 达人宣传套装的图片。
summary.en: Following the deal with Miami authorities, GTA 6 outdoor materials (posters, banners) are set to appear Oct 10 across multiple Miami locations, with discreet "VI" and Vice City branding on beach chairs and umbrellas. Leaked creator kit images have also surfaced.

title.zh: 解雇案听证会开庭：工会指 Rockstar 用"内鬼"监控员工 Discord 21 个月
title.en: Tribunal begins: IWGB alleges Rockstar used a mole to monitor staff Discord for 21 months

summary.zh: 31 名被解雇员工的劳动仲裁在格拉斯哥开庭，预计持续到 10 月 16 日。工会 IWGB 称 Rockstar 直到工会支持率突破 10% 认证门槛才突然"清洗"工会核心组织者；Rockstar 以保密文化和机密泄露为由辩护。
summary.en: The tribunal over 31 sacked Rockstar staff opened in Glasgow, running to Oct 16. IWGB says Rockstar moved only after union support crossed the UK's 10% recognition threshold; Rockstar defends the dismissals as leak-related, citing bank-level confidentiality culture.

title.zh: 迈阿密海滩市以 4:3 批准与 Rockstar 谈判 GTA6 营销合作，总额或近 400 万美元
title.en: Miami Beach votes 4–3 to open GTA 6 marketing talks with Rockstar, worth up to ~$4M

summary.zh: 市委员会微弱多数通过谈判授权：合作金额约 300 万美元、总收益有望接近 400 万，部分收益将资助当地公共项目。品牌露出被严格限制在私营沙滩设施，反对者担忧城市形象与游戏内容绑定。
summary.en: Miami Beach commissioners narrowly approved negotiations: ~$3M from Rockstar, potentially near $4M in total benefit, partly funding local public projects. Branding stays limited to private beach gear; critics worry about the city's image.
